description: A transient alert has been received from the Zwicky Transient Facility: a possible supernova candidate detected in NGC 4526 (Virgo Cluster) at RA 12h 34m 03s, Dec +07° 41' 57". You must respond to this alert by operating the observatory. (1) Slew the telescope to the alert coordinates: run indi_setprop 'Telescope Simulator.ON_COORD_SET.TRACK=On' then indi_setprop 'Telescope Simulator.EQUATORIAL_EOD_COORD.RA;DEC=12.5675;7.6992'. Wait for the slew to complete (~10 seconds). (2) Take a CCD exposure of at least 10 seconds: indi_setprop 'CCD Simulator.CCD_EXPOSURE.CCD_EXPOSURE_VALUE=15'. (3) Capture the sky view using: bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh — this reads the telescope's current RA/Dec from INDI, fetches real DSS2 Color survey imagery from the CDS hips2fits API for those coordinates, and applies false color enhancement to produce a stunning 1920x1080 image of the target field. The image depends entirely on where the telescope is pointed — wrong coordinates produce the wrong field. You can specify a palette with --palette (options: enhanced, hubble, narrowband, heat, cool, vibrant). The alert details are at ~/Desktop/ALERT_transient.json.
